This appendix presents an interactive version of the `mapSpain::esp_codelist`
dataset. It contains Spanish subdivision codes from several coding standards
and name variants in multiple languages.

## Spanish subdivision codes and names

```{r}
#| label: esp_codelist
#| echo: false
library(mapSpain)
library(reactable)

data(esp_codelist)

reactable(
  esp_codelist,
  filterable = TRUE,
  searchable = TRUE,
  showPageSizeOptions = TRUE,
  striped = TRUE,
  paginationType = "jump",
  elementId = "esp_codelist"
)
```
